Container.Name: kb-postgres
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 17 with the pgvector extension - the database behind the shared knowledge library. STARTED IN ORDER: kb-postgres first, then kb-service, then kb-webui. There is no template equivalent of compose depends_on, so nothing enforces that for you. NETWORK: the kb containers share one user-defined Docker network named kb that you create once, by hand, before the first start (a template cannot create a network, so Network stays bridge here - set it to kb when you create the container). On that network this container is reachable by its container name, kb-postgres, on port 5432. Docker must preserve user-defined networks across updates (Unraid: Settings > Docker, Preserve user defined networks = Yes), or the containers fall back to bridge and that name stops resolving. EXPOSURE: this template publishes no host port, so the database is reachable only from a container on the kb network, not from the wider network this host is on. STORAGE: the data mount holds the whole database - set it to a path on a pool and put it under backup. CREDENTIALS: the password is set once, at the first start of an empty data directory, and must match what kb-service is given. IMAGE TAG: pinned to one pgvector release on PostgreSQL 17; a major-version change is a dump and restore, not an Update.
Container.Description: PostgreSQL 17 with pgvector for the knowledge library. Start this first. Reachable only on the kb network; publishes no host port.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: REQUIRED. The database files. Set an absolute path on a POOL, e.g. /mnt/<pool>/appdata/kb-postgres/data - not the user-share FUSE overlay. Put it under backup.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: REQUIRED. Password of the database user, set at the first start of an empty data directory. Use a long random value and give the same one to kb-service.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Database user created at the first start.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database created at the first start.
